checked: event identities, exact integer ns, init before window end, three independent units and eight reference windows; no raw bag decode or coordinates/results read

processing_policy.field_model: conditional; unverified geometric-center to odom-origin equivalence
processing_policy.heading: nominal room +X at start; 5deg inherited prior, not calibrated heading uncertainty
processing_policy.initialization: first 5s after recorded start stable begins; four-wall nonlinear least squares only; no manual XY used by estimator
processing_policy.clock: VM bag receipt association; preserve original header and prefix availability; no physical clock calibration claim
processing_policy.odom: latest arrived receipt at/before state time; max age 0.5s; skip frame if either missing; retain actual cumulative XY and quaternion yaw
processing_policy.gyro: published Z engineering axis; left hold max100ms; no complete angular factor on any gap; no odom angular fallback
processing_policy.weights: unchanged inherited engineering weights and zero range corrections, not calibrated probabilities
processing_policy.peer: car1 node_0 only; reverse direction not duplicated as independent factor
processing_policy.evaluation: all four manually measured stable windows; valid and failure coverage separate; no reference interpolation through motion
processing_policy.main_scope: conditional reserved stop-point confirmation; no continuous position truth
processing_policy.heldout: decode only after FINAL_LOCK; references enter evaluation only
processing_policy.limits: no parameter search, no new field collection, no old batch rerun; max1200s per cell CPU1
processing_policy.segment_reset: fresh graph, prior, angular buffer and history per unit; no bridge across B2 gap
processing_policy.failure: preserve all scheduled frames; missing odom invalidates frame; invalid gyro supplies no angular factor; preparation exceptions unavailable; run exceptions abort and pad remaining frames invalid; no silent retries or tuning

methods.M3W025: same plus peer information weight 0.25 (residual and Jacobian multiplied by 0.5)

evaluation_policy.windows: all eight predeclared measured stable windows, report initialization and post-motion stops separately
evaluation_policy.denominator: scheduled, own valid, three-method common-valid per car/window; accuracy only on common-valid
evaluation_policy.reference_sensitivity: assumed coordinate bounds +/-0.02m per axis, conservative sqrt(2)*0.02m radius; not calibrated confidence interval
evaluation_policy.references: after lock, transcribe existing sources with provenance and independent readback; no new measurement, selection, interpolation or estimator input
evaluation_policy.independence: B2 units are split recordings of one experiment, not independent replicates; repeated stop frames are correlated
evaluation_policy.claims: conditional stop-point accuracy and availability; no moving-trajectory accuracy, calibrated safety probability or IMU benefit claim from these three IMU-enabled arms
